His obeisant tone sounded polite but nervous. 他恭順的語氣聽起來有禮但緊張。

meaning: 恭敬地；順從地
sentences: She bowed obeisantly before entering the hall. 她進入大廳前恭敬地鞠躬。
The servant answered obeisantly and stepped aside. 侍者恭敬地回答後退到一旁。

meaning: 較少見用法，等同於 obeahism，指 obeah 的信仰或做法。
sentences: Some older sources use obeism as a variant of obeahism. 有些較早期的資料會把 obeism 當作 obeahism 的變體。
The scholar compared obeism with related spiritual traditions in the region. 那位學者比較了 obeism 與當地其他相關的靈性傳統。

meaning: Obelia 屬的群體性海洋水螅。
sentences: The students observed obelia colonies under the microscope during biology lab. 生物實驗課時，學生們用顯微鏡觀察 obelia 群體。
Obelia often appears as a delicate branching growth attached to rocks. obelia 常呈現為附著在岩石上的細小分枝狀生長體。

meaning: 與此有關、屬於或位於此附近的。
sentences: The surgeon noted an obeliac landmark near the top of the skull. 外科醫師指出頭骨頂部附近的一個 obeliac 標記點。
The paper compares several obeliac measurements from the specimens. 那篇論文比較了那些樣本的幾項 obeliac 測量值。

meaning: 與 obelion 有關的。
sentences: The obelial region was marked for reference in the anatomy diagram. 解剖圖上把 obelial 區域標記出來作為參考。
Researchers discussed minor variation in the obelial area of the skull. 研究人員討論了頭骨 obelial 區域中的細微差異。

meaning: 人字縫附近頂骨孔之間矢狀縫上的顱骨測量點。
sentences: The anatomy instructor pointed out the obelion on the skull model. 解剖學老師在頭骨模型上指出了 obelion 的位置。
Researchers recorded the distance from the obelion to other craniometric landmarks. 研究人員記錄了 obelion 到其他顱骨測量點的距離。

meaning: 類似或屬於方尖碑。
sentences: The monument's obeliscal form made it easy to spot from afar. 那座紀念碑具有方尖碑般的外形，從遠處就很容易辨認。
The architect chose an obeliscal silhouette for the memorial design. 建築師為那座紀念設施採用了方尖碑式的輪廓。

meaning: 以方尖碑的形式。
sentences: The ancient marker has an obeliscar shape that narrows toward the top. 那座古老的標記物具有方尖碑式的形狀，往上逐漸收窄。
Several obeliscar monuments line the entrance to the cemetery. 墓園入口排列著幾座方尖碑形的紀念碑。

meaning: 一種高大、方形、錐形的巨石，頂部有一個金字塔尖，經常用作紀念碑。
sentences: A granite obelisk stands in the center of the memorial square. 廣場中央矗立著一座花崗岩方尖碑。
Tourists gathered around the ancient obelisk to take photos. 遊客聚集在那座古老的方尖碑旁拍照。

meaning: 類似方尖碑。
sentences: The tower has an obeliskoid outline against the evening sky. 那座塔在傍晚天空下呈現出方尖碑般的輪廓。
Designers chose an obeliskoid column for the central feature. 設計師為中心主體選用了方尖碑式的立柱。

meaning: 在頁邊空白處設置標記來註釋手稿的做法。
sentences: The editor explained obelism as the practice of marking doubtful passages in a text. 編者解釋說，obelism 是在文本中標記可疑段落的做法。
Ancient scholars used obelism to note lines they believed were spurious. 古代學者會用 obelism 標示他們認為可疑或偽託的句子。

meaning: 以方碑標記（書面或印刷的段落）；判斷為虛假或可疑。
sentences: The critic chose to obelize the disputed lines in the manuscript. 那位評註者決定把手稿裡有爭議的句子標記出來。
Editors may obelize a passage if they suspect it was added later. 如果編者懷疑某段文字是後來增補的，就可能會加上標記。

meaning: 短劍號；古代用來標記可疑文字的符號，也常指除號 ÷。
sentences: The editor used an obelus to mark the doubtful line in the manuscript. 編者用 obelus 標記手稿中那一行存疑的文字。
In some contexts, the division sign is called an obelus. 在某些語境中，除號也被稱為 obelus。

meaning: 天王星最外層的主要衛星。
sentences: Oberon is the outermost of Uranus's major moons. Oberon 是天王星最外圍的主要衛星。
Astronomers compared images of Oberon taken over several decades. 天文學家比較了數十年間拍攝的 Oberon 影像。

meaning: 肥胖的；過胖的。
sentences: Doctors warn that obese patients may face a higher risk of heart disease. 醫師提醒，肥胖的病患可能面臨較高的心臟病風險。
The cat had become obese from lack of exercise and too many snacks. 那隻貓因為缺乏運動又吃太多零食，變得過胖。

meaning: 以肥胖的方式。
sentences: The older text describes the figure as obesely proportioned. 那份較早期的文本形容那個身形比例顯得肥胖。
The character was drawn obesely to exaggerate his appearance. 那個角色被畫得偏胖，好突顯他的外貌特徵。

meaning: 肥胖；過胖的狀態。
sentences: The report discusses childhood obeseness and diet habits. 那份報告探討兒童肥胖與飲食習慣之間的關係。
Doctors advised him to address his obeseness before it caused further problems. 醫師建議他及早改善肥胖狀況，以免引發更多問題。

meaning: 肥胖的狀態。
sentences: Obesity increases the risk of diabetes, heart disease, and other health problems. 肥胖會提高糖尿病、心臟病和其他健康問題的風險。
The campaign aims to reduce childhood obesity through better nutrition and exercise. 那項宣導活動希望透過更好的營養與運動來降低兒童肥胖。

meaning: 腦部第四腦室頂部的一片薄三角形灰質結構。
sentences: The anatomy text labels the obex near the lower end of the fourth ventricle. 那本解剖學教材把 obex 標在第四腦室下端附近。
Medical students often memorize the location of the obex when studying the brainstem. 醫學生在學習腦幹時，常會背下 obex 的位置。

meaning: 服從
sentences: Every citizen should obey the laws and regulations of the country. 每一位公民都應該遵守國家的法律與法規。
The well-trained dog immediately obeyed its owner's command. 那隻訓練有素的狗立即服從了主人的命令。

meaning: 銀行存款餘額
sentences: You can use "obey bank balance" in emails and daily conversations. 你可以在 email 和日常對話中使用「obey bank balance」。
After practice, I could use "obey bank balance" more confidently. 練習後，我更有自信地使用「obey bank balance」。

meaning: 能夠被服從。
sentences: A law should be clear enough to be obeyable in everyday life. 一項法律應該清楚到足以讓人們在日常生活中遵守。
The teacher rewrote the instructions so they were simple and obeyable. 老師重新改寫了指示，讓內容更簡單也更容易遵守。

meaning: 一個服從的人。
sentences: He was known as a loyal obeyer of the king's commands. 他以忠實服從國王命令而聞名。
The story contrasts a quiet obeyer with a rebellious brother. 這個故事把一位安靜的服從者和叛逆的兄弟做了對比。

meaning: 乖乖地
sentences: The child stood obeyingly beside her mother during the ceremony. 儀式進行時，那個孩子乖乖地站在母親身旁。
The dog sat obeyingly when its owner gave the signal. 主人一下指令，那隻狗就乖乖地坐下。

meaning: 可被混淆的；可被刻意弄得難懂的。
sentences: Not every part of the codebase is equally obfuscable without breaking the build. 並不是程式碼庫的每一部分都能在不破壞建置的情況下被混淆處理。
Sensitive logic may be technically obfuscable, but it should still be well protected. 敏感邏輯在技術上或許可以被混淆，但仍然需要妥善保護。

meaning: 使難懂；把事情故意弄得模糊或複雜。
sentences: The report uses technical jargon to obfuscate what really went wrong. 那份報告用一堆技術術語，把真正出了什麼問題講得模糊不清。
Some developers obfuscate their code to make it harder to reverse-engineer. 有些開發者會混淆程式碼，讓別人更難逆向分析。

meaning: 刻意把事情弄得難懂的行為；也可指程式碼混淆。
sentences: His answer was full of obfuscation and avoided the main issue. 他的回答充滿閃爍其詞，始終迴避主要問題。
Code obfuscation can slow attackers down, but it does not replace real security. 程式碼混淆可以拖慢攻擊者，但無法取代真正的安全措施。

meaning: 故意把事情說得模糊的人；也可指程式碼混淆工具。
sentences: Critics accused the spokesperson of being an obfuscator rather than a clear communicator. 批評者指責那位發言人不是在清楚說明，而是在刻意混淆視聽。
The build pipeline runs an obfuscator before releasing the app. 建置流程會在發布應用程式前先執行混淆工具。

meaning: 較少見用法，指混淆、晦澀或難以理解的狀態。
sentences: The essay's obfuscity made it difficult for readers to follow the argument. 那篇文章過於晦澀，讓讀者難以跟上它的論證。
He replaced clarity with obfuscity and confused the audience. 他放棄清楚表達，改以晦澀說法把聽眾弄糊塗了。

meaning: 陰暗的；朦朧難解的；晦澀的。
sentences: The novel opens with an obfuscous description of a stormy coastline. 那本小說一開頭就以晦暗朦朧的筆法描寫暴風中的海岸線。
His obfuscous answer left the audience more puzzled than before. 他那段含糊晦澀的回答讓聽眾比之前更困惑。

meaning: 與和服搭配的腰帶。
sentences: She tied a bright red obi over her summer kimono. 她在夏季和服外繫上一條鮮紅色的 obi。
The shop sells handmade obi in both formal and casual styles. 那家店販售手工製作的 obi，有正式款也有休閒款。

meaning: 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Obidicut。
sentences: Writers use Obidicut for rare or specialized English term recorded as Obidicut. 作家將 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Obidicut。 用於罕見或專業的英語術語，記錄為 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Obidicut。。
The word Obidicut still appears in older books and notes. 一個罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 Obidicut。這個詞仍然出現在較舊的書籍和筆記中。

meaning: 斑點鷹魟
sentences: In some Spanish-speaking regions, obispo is used as a name for the spotted eagle ray. 在一些西語地區，obispo 會被用來指斑點鷹魟。
The guide pointed to the obispo gliding above the reef. 導遊指著那隻從礁石上方滑過的 obispo。

meaning: 訃聞；訃告；obituary 的縮略說法。
sentences: I read her obit in the local paper this morning. 我今天早上在地方報紙上讀到了她的訃聞。
The magazine published a short obit for the retired actor. 那本雜誌為那位退休演員刊出了一則簡短的訃告。

meaning: 屬於或與訃聞有關的。
sentences: The archive includes several obitual notices from the nineteenth century. 那份檔案包含幾則十九世紀的訃聞性公告。
Her article took on an obitual tone after the famous actor died. 那位知名演員過世後，她的文章帶上了一種訃聞式的語氣。

meaning: 寫訃聞的人。
sentences: The newspaper's senior obituarian had written thousands of life summaries. 那家報社的資深 obituarian 撰寫過上千篇人物訃聞。
A skilled obituarian can capture a whole life in a few paragraphs. 優秀的 obituarian 能用短短幾段文字概括一個人的一生。

meaning: 以訃聞的形式或透過訃聞的方式。
sentences: The magazine reviewed his life obituarily after news of his death broke. 那本雜誌在他去世的消息傳出後，以訃聞形式回顧了他的一生。
The event was discussed obituarily in several newspapers the next day. 隔天有幾家報紙以訃聞式的筆調討論了那起事件。

meaning: 訃聞撰稿人
sentences: The obituarist interviewed relatives before writing the piece. 訃聞撰稿人寫稿前先採訪親屬。
She works as an obituarist for a national newspaper. 她在一家全國性報紙擔任訃聞撰稿人。

meaning: 撰寫訃聞
sentences: The editor asked her to obituarize the retired judge. 編輯請她為那位退休法官撰寫訃聞。
Newspaper staff sometimes obituarize public figures on short notice. 報社人員有時得臨時為公眾人物撰寫訃聞。

meaning: 訃聞；報紙或刊物上刊載的逝者生平簡介。
sentences: I read her obituary in the Sunday paper. 我在週日報紙上讀到了她的訃聞。
The obituary highlighted his work as a teacher and community leader. 那篇訃聞特別提到了他作為教師與社區領袖的貢獻。

meaning: 目的
sentences: The mysterious object in the night sky was later identified as a satellite. 夜空中那個神秘物體後來被證實是衛星。
The main object of our project is to reduce environmental pollution. 我們專案的主要目標是減少環境污染。

meaning: 可提出異議的
sentences: The lawyer found several objectable points in the contract. 律師在合約中找到幾個可提出異議之處。
That claim is objectable because it lacks evidence. 那項主張缺乏證據，因此可提出異議。

meaning: 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為反對。
sentences: Writers use objectation for rare or specialized English term recorded as objectation. 作者使用 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為反對。 來表示罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為 一個罕見的或專門的英語術語，記錄為反對。。
The word objectation still appears in older books and notes. 「反對」一詞仍然出現在較舊的書籍和筆記中。

meaning: 記錄為客觀的罕見或專門的英語術語。
sentences: Writers use objectative for rare or specialized English term recorded as objectative. 作者使用賓語來表示罕見或專門的英語術語，記錄為受詞。
The word objectative still appears in older books and notes. 客觀這個詞仍然出現在較舊的書籍和筆記中。

meaning: 被反對的人；遭異議者
sentences: The objectee had a chance to answer the complaint. 被反對的人有機會回應申訴。
In the meeting notes, the objectee was listed beside the objection. 會議紀錄中，被異議者列在反對意見旁。

meaning: 物體性；作為物體的狀態
sentences: The sculpture plays with the idea of objecthood. 這件雕塑探討物體性的概念。
In philosophy class, we discussed objecthood and perception. 哲學課上，我們討論了物體性與知覺。

meaning: 物化；客體化；也可指把抽象概念具體化的過程。
sentences: The article criticizes the objectification of women in advertising. 那篇文章批評廣告中對女性的物化。
In philosophy, objectification can also mean giving concrete form to an abstract idea. 在哲學裡，objectification 也可以指把抽象概念具體化。

meaning: 把…當成物品看待；也可指把抽象概念具體化。
sentences: The campaign asks viewers not to objectify people based on appearance. 那項宣傳活動呼籲大家不要只憑外表把人當成物品看待。
Charts can help objectify complex data so that patterns are easier to see. 圖表可以把複雜資料具體化，讓人更容易看出其中的模式。

meaning: 異議
sentences: The manager raised an objection to the new project proposal today. 經理今天對新專案提案提出了異議（異議）。
If you have any objections to the plan, please let me know now. 如果您對該計畫有任何異議，請現在告訴我。

meaning: 令人反感或可被反對的性質。
sentences: The committee debated the objectionability of the ad's violent content. 委員會討論那支廣告暴力內容是否令人反感。
Parents raised concerns about the objectionability of the material for younger children. 家長對這份教材是否適合年幼孩子提出疑慮。

meaning: 令人反感的；令人不能接受的；可被反對的。
sentences: Some viewers found the joke objectionable and complained to the station. 有些觀眾覺得那個笑話令人反感，於是向電台投訴。
There was nothing legally objectionable in the contract, but the wording was confusing. 那份合約在法律上沒有可反對之處，但措辭相當令人困惑。

meaning: 令人反感的品質。
sentences: The debate centered on the objectionableness of the violent scenes. 這場辯論的焦點在於那些暴力場景是否令人反感。
Parents questioned the objectionableness of the lyrics for younger listeners. 家長質疑那些歌詞對年幼聽眾來說是否不妥。

meaning: 以令人反感的方式。
sentences: He spoke objectionably to the staff and was asked to leave. 他對員工說話十分無禮，最後被要求離開。
The ad presented the issue so objectionably that many viewers complained. 那支廣告呈現議題的方式太惹人反感，許多觀眾因此投訴。

meaning: 可反對的；令人反感的。
sentences: Some parents found the film's language objectional for younger viewers. 有些家長認為這部電影的用語對年幼觀眾來說並不妥當。
The proposal was not illegal, but several members considered it objectional. 那項提案雖然不違法，但有幾位成員認為它有可反對之處。

meaning: 提出合法異議的人。
sentences: Each objectioner was asked to submit written evidence before the hearing. 每位提出異議的人都被要求在聽證會前提交書面證據。
The lawyer spoke on behalf of several objectioners to the zoning plan. 那位律師代表幾位反對分區計畫的人發言。

meaning: 反對某項行動或政策的人。
sentences: Every objectionist was invited to explain their concerns at the meeting. 每位反對者都被邀請在會議中說明自己的顧慮。
The article describes him as a persistent objectionist to the new policy. 那篇文章形容他是新政策的堅定反對者。

meaning: 屬於或關於句子的受詞。
sentences: In grammar class, we discussed the objectival use of the pronoun in that sentence. 在文法課上，我們討論了那個句子裡代名詞作為受詞的用法。
The teacher highlighted the objectival phrase in blue. 老師用藍色標出了那個受詞性的片語。

meaning: 客觀化。
sentences: The diagram helps objectivate an abstract theory for new students. 這張圖幫助新生把抽象理論具體化。
Writers often objectivate emotions by turning them into vivid images. 作家常把情感轉化成鮮明的意象，使它們具體化。

meaning: 將概念或抽象轉化為物件。
sentences: The sculpture is an objectivation of the artist's grief. 那座雕塑是藝術家悲傷情感的具體化表現。
In philosophy, objectivation can describe the process of giving form to an idea. 在哲學裡，objectivation 可以指把觀念轉化成具體形式的過程。

meaning: 目標；目的。
sentences: The main objective of our study is to improve urban health. 我們研究的主要目標是提升都市健康。
Her objective this year is to save enough money to study abroad. 她今年的目標是存夠錢出國留學。

meaning: 以公正、客觀的方式。
sentences: We need to evaluate the evidence objectively before making a decision. 我們需要先客觀地評估證據，再做決定。
She tried to speak objectively even though the issue affected her personally. 儘管這件事和她切身相關，她還是努力客觀地發言。

meaning: 客觀的特質；中立性。
sentences: Good journalism depends on accuracy and objectiveness. 良好的新聞報導依賴準確性與客觀性。
The judge was respected for his calm objectiveness. 那位法官因為冷靜而客觀，受到大家尊敬。

meaning: 客觀主義；強調客觀現實或客觀價值有效性的理論或觀點。
sentences: The seminar compared objectivism with more subjective approaches to ethics. 那場研討會比較了客觀主義與較偏主觀的倫理觀點。
Her essay argues that strict objectivism leaves too little room for personal experience. 她的文章主張，過於嚴格的客觀主義為個人經驗留下的空間太少。

meaning: 客觀主義者；也可作形容詞，指客觀主義的。
sentences: He describes himself as an objectivist in matters of ethics. 他形容自己在倫理議題上是個客觀主義者。
The article examines objectivist arguments about truth and reason. 那篇文章探討客觀主義對真理與理性的論證。

meaning: 客觀主義的；帶有客觀主義傾向的。
sentences: The critic called the essay overly objectivistic in tone. 評論者認為那篇文章的語氣過於偏向客觀主義。
